name: i18n Key Diff
description: Compare translation files for missing, extra, empty, untranslated, placeholder-mismatched and duplicate keys, and fill them back in the original format
help: Supports JSON (nested objects and arrays), Flutter ARB (@ metadata ignored), YAML and Java properties. The first (starred) file is the baseline; up to 20 files at a time, read locally only.

Rules: missing = in the baseline but not in the file; extra = in the file but not in the baseline; empty = the baseline has text but the file is empty; possibly untranslated = identical to the baseline (which has at least two letters besides placeholders); duplicate = appears more than once in a file (the last one wins).

Placeholders recognized: {{name}}, {name} / {0} / ICU plural and select (branch text excluded), %s / %1$s / %@ and %{name}. Named and positional placeholders only need to be present; sequential %s must also match in count.

Pick a target file to edit translations right in the table and optionally fill missing keys with empty values or the baseline text, then preview before writing. JSON / ARB keep key order and indentation; properties are edited line by line with comments kept. YAML would lose comments when regenerated, so it is compared but not written.
